extracted.name: Jacket potato board
extracted.description: A hit on social media, these jacket potatoes are smaller than traditional jackets and served with a variety of fillings
ingredient_lines: a dash each of Tabasco or Worcestershire sauce (optional)
1 tsp mango chutney plus a little extra to serve
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 4. Choose the smaller potatoes from the pack and tip onto a baking tray, rub with the oil and season to coat. Bake for 50 mins–1 hr until tender and the skin is crisp.
Mix all the ingredients for each filling in separate bowls and season.
Cut crosses into the jackets and arrange on a serving board. Use each of the fillings to fill two potatoes each and arrange side by side. Add a little more mango chutney to the coronation chicken.
